headerDisplay: Runs your Heatmiser neoHub routines from HomeKit, and shows each zone's temperature as a sensor. Talks to the hub over your local network; second-generation neoHub required.
footerDisplay: Create the API token in the Neo app under Settings > API. See the [README](https://github.com/rdawson6/homebridge-neohub-routines#readme) for details.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log for this platform.

token.title: API Token
token.description: Token created in the Neo app under Settings > API.

host.title: Hub IP Address
host.description: Leave empty to find the hub automatically. Setting it gives faster, more reliable startup.

zoneSensors.title: Show zone temperature sensors
zoneSensors.description: Adds a temperature sensor for each thermostat zone, for use in HomeKit automations.

excludeRoutines.title: Hidden routines
excludeRoutines.description: Routine names (exactly as in the Neo app) that should not appear in HomeKit.

routineRefreshMinutes.title: Routine list refresh (minutes)
routineRefreshMinutes.description: How often to re-read the routine list from the hub.

temperatureRefreshSeconds.title: Temperature refresh (seconds)
temperatureRefreshSeconds.description: How often to read zone temperatures. The hub only updates them about every 90 seconds.

commandGapSeconds.title: Gap between hub commands (seconds)
commandGapSeconds.description: The hub stops responding if commands arrive too quickly. Increase this if you see timeouts.
